packages.brief:
You are an implementation agent for work package BT-W0-01, "Core contracts: Package.swift, errors, seam, leaf types, every core stub" (Wave 0, size L), of the Angstrom Bluetooth port (a Swift 6 SwiftPM library porting pylamarzocco). You work alone in your own git worktree of the Angstrom repo, on branch bt/bt-w0-01, branched from bluetooth/integration; you cannot talk to other agents. Read first: CLAUDE.md; docs/bluetooth/SPEC.md sections §3.10; §4.11 (merge rule); §5.1; §5.3; §6.1–§6.15; §7.1; §12 D8; PLAN §3.0; PLAN §3.1; docs/bluetooth/PLAN.md §1 (execution rules), §3 (plan-level contracts) and §3.5 (test conventions). The reference of record is pylamarzocco v2.5.6 (commit 4c639ee), read-only at $UPSTREAM; relevant upstream lines: $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/clients/_bluetooth.py:40-54; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/clients/_bluetooth.py:57-64; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/const.py:11-31; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/const.py:141-146; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/const.py:182; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/const.py:198-218; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/const.py:260-275; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/const.py:307-339; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/models/_bluetooth.py:22-213; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/devices/_machine.py:58-84; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/exceptions.py:20-47; $UPSTREAM/src/pylamarzocco/models/_general.py:128-136; $UPSTREAM/tests/fixtures/machine/shot_counter_2026-10-05.txt. Copy every wire value (UUIDs, JSON keys, raw values, error texts, timings, counts, orders) from $UPSTREAM or the SPEC verbatim, never from memory. SPEC §6 and PLAN §3 declarations are frozen: never rename, retype, reorder parameters of, or change the access level of one. Anything you add follows the SPEC §6 access rule: private/fileprivate in Sources/ and Tests/AngstromTestSupport; internal XCTestCase classes and test methods with private helpers in test files; internal command types and option properties in cli/. You may create ONLY: Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothConstants.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothTransport.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothAuthToken.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothEnums.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothModels.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothWireCoercion.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothShotCounterModels.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothDiagnostics.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothCodec.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothResponseDecoder.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BrewingStateMachine.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/Dashboard+Bluetooth.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/BluetoothOpTable.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/LaMarzoccoBluetoothClient.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/LaMarzoccoBluetoothClient+Requests.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/LaMarzoccoBluetoothClient+ShotCounter.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Bluetooth/LaMarzoccoBluetoothClient+Discovery.swift, Sources/Angstrom/LaMarzoccoCloudClient+BluetoothToken.swift, Sources/AngstromBluetooth/BluetoothTransport+CoreBluetooth.swift, Tests/AngstromTestSupport/AngstromTestSupport.swift, Tests/AngstromTestSupport/Fixtures/shot_counter_2026-10-05.txt; and modify ONLY: Package.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Models.swift, Sources/Angstrom/Commands.swift. Touch no other file, never commit Package.resolved or .build, never construct CBCentralManager/CBPeripheral in a test (no Bluetooth hardware exists), use only macOS 14/iOS 17 APIs (no Mutex, no Task.immediate), XCTest only, no wall-clock sleeps or sleep-polling in tests. Parity tests start with the doc comment `/// Upstream: <test function> (<path>:<line>) [<case ids>]`; Angstrom-only tests start with `/// Angstrom-only: <id> — <one line>`. If the SPEC is wrong or unimplementable as written, STOP and report `SPEC-DEFECT: <section>: <problem>: <proposed amendment>`; do not improvise. If code from an earlier package is defective, keep a test that proves it, start it with `try XCTSkipIf(true, "BLOCKED-BY <owner-id>: <reason>")` and report it. Remove every `unimplemented: BT-W0-01` stub marker. When every acceptance command exits 0, commit with message `BT-W0-01: <summary>` and reply with: changed files, exact test names added, deviations, BLOCKED-BY items, open questions.

TASK: Land the compile-time skeleton of the whole core Bluetooth surface so every later package compiles and can be tested in isolation. (1) Package.swift exactly per the SPEC §7.1 row: add product `.library(name: "AngstromBluetooth", targets: ["AngstromBluetooth"])`, target `.target(name: "AngstromBluetooth", dependencies: ["Angstrom"])`, target `.target(name: "AngstromTestSupport", dependencies: ["Angstrom"], path: "Tests/AngstromTestSupport", resources: [.copy("Fixtures")])`, and add "AngstromTestSupport" to the dependencies of BOTH test targets. No unsafeFlags, no new package dependency. (2) Sources/Angstrom/Models.swift: SPEC §6.4 verbatim. Append the five cases at the END of LaMarzoccoError, add their errorDescription texts character for character, add `isBluetoothConnectionFailure` (true for .bluetoothConnectionFailed, .bluetoothAuthenticationFailed, .bluetoothUnavailable), and reword the doc comments at Models.swift:25-26 and :29-31. hardwareChecklist.step: `angcli ble scan`, then `angcli ble gatt --peripheral <id>` on every available model
